channel.title: EngineerzCorneR — Posts
channel.description: Deep-dive technical write-ups across Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Automation, Civil and Solar.

item.title: Functional Safety & SIL Explained
item.description: What a Safety Integrity Level really measures: PFDavg and PFH bands, SFF/HFT architectural constraints, voting, and a worked SIF example (IEC 61508/61511).

item.title: Alarm Setpoint Bands: Why High and High-High Are Different Alarms
item.description: Why alarms come in High/High-High and Low/Low-Low pairs, not single trip points, and how a reset deadband on each keeps the alarm list from flooding operators.

item.title: IECEx / ATEX Zones vs NEC Class & Division: Hazardous Area Classification
item.description: How the IEC 60079/ATEX Zone system compares to the North American NEC Class & Division system — equivalency table, gas/dust groups, and Ex protection types.

item.title: PLC vs DCS vs SCADA Explained: Real Industrial Comparison
item.description: PLC, DCS and SCADA compared for real industrial use — control type, speed, architecture, redundancy, and where control execution happens.

item.title: Relief Valve Orifice Sizing
item.description: Set pressure, allowable overpressure, back pressure, and required relieving rate — the inputs that decide a relief valve's required orifice area under API 520, and why the scenario matters more than the formula.

item.title: Tank Breathing Losses
item.description: A sealed, idle storage tank still vents every day — thermal breathing from ambient temperature swings, plus working losses from filling and emptying, with normal venting requirements estimated using API 2000-style methods (confirm against the current edition).

item.title: Elapsed Time Calculations
item.description: Why subtracting clock times like decimal numbers gives the wrong answer — time runs on base 60 for seconds and minutes and base 24 for hours, and borrowing across those bases is where the errors creep in.

item.title: DC/AC Ratio & Inverter Clipping
item.description: An array almost never delivers its nameplate power, so sizing the inverter to the array's full rating usually wastes money — the DC/AC ratio and clipping trade-off explained.

item.title: String vs Microinverter vs Power Optimizer: Choosing a Solar Inverter Topology
item.description: How string inverters, microinverters and power optimizers differ in where MPPT happens, what a shaded panel costs under each, and how to pick between them.

item.title: HVAC System Components Explained
item.description: How an HVAC system conditions a space, component by component — compressor, condenser, expansion device, evaporator, air handler, ductwork, and controls.

item.title: Refrigerant Types: R-410A to A2L
item.description: Why HVAC is transitioning away from R-410A, the ASHRAE 34 safety classification (A1/A2L/B2L), R-32 vs R-454B vs R-1234yf vs natural refrigerants compared by GWP and flammability, what changes for A2L handling, and a selection reference.

item.title: Superheat & Subcooling Explained
item.description: Superheat and subcooling are just temperature differences from saturation — but read together with suction and liquid pressures they separate low charge, overcharge, restrictions and airflow problems.

item.title: Manning's Equation: How Pipe Slope, Roughness and Diameter Set Flow Capacity
item.description: How Manning's equation turns pipe slope, roughness and diameter into gravity flow capacity, why full-bore isn't peak capacity, and what roughness represents.

item.title: Rational Method: How Peak Stormwater Runoff Is Estimated
item.description: Q = C × i × A looks simple, but the runoff coefficient, the time of concentration and the design storm behind the intensity decide whether the peak flow you size a pipe for is realistic.

item.title: Conventional vs. Balanced Bellows vs. Pilot-Operated PSV: Choosing a Relief Valve Type
item.description: Three ways a relief valve holds its disc shut until set pressure — how back pressure and dirty service decide between conventional, bellows, or pilot-operated.

item.title: Binary, Hex & Octal Explained
item.description: Decimal, binary, octal and hex are all the same number in different bases — what a base actually means, why hex exists as shorthand for binary, and how to convert between them by hand.

item.title: Dimensional Analysis Explained
item.description: Unit conversion errors almost always come from memorizing factors instead of tracking units through the arithmetic — how dimensional analysis catches the mistake before the answer does.

item.title: Order-of-Magnitude Checks
item.description: A one-line estimate rounded to a single significant figure catches most decimal-point and unit-slip errors before they reach a real calculation — how order-of-magnitude checks actually work.

item.title: CT Sizing & Burden Explained
item.description: Ratio, burden, accuracy class, and short-circuit withstand — the four specs behind every current transformer, and why a CT that reads perfectly at normal load can still fail during a fault.

item.title: How to Select a Digital Protection Relay
item.description: A step-by-step working method for selecting a digital protection relay — from identifying the protected equipment through CT/VT matching, I/O sizing.

item.title: Power Transformer, CT & PT: Internal Construction
item.description: The internal construction of a power transformer, current transformer (CT), and potential transformer (PT/VT) — parts, ratings, and a side-by-side comparison.

item.title: LMTD Heat Exchanger Sizing
item.description: Log-mean temperature difference explained — why it isn't just an average of the two ends, why counter-current beats co-current for the same terminal temperatures, and where the F correction factor comes in.

item.title: NPSH Available Explained
item.description: NPSHa broken down term by term — source pressure head, static elevation, suction-line friction losses, and vapor pressure — and why temperature quietly decides most marginal cases.

item.title: Markup vs Margin Explained
item.description: Markup and margin use the same two numbers — cost and price — but divide by a different one, so the same percentage means two different prices depending on which you mean.

item.title: Percentage Points vs Percent Change: Why They're Not the Same Number
item.description: Why 'up 5 percentage points' and 'up 5 percent' are two different numbers, and how mixing them up leads to real reporting errors.

item.title: NPSH Margin: Why 'NPSHa > NPSHr' Isn't Enough on Its Own
item.description: Pump hydraulic and shaft power sizing, and why an NPSH margin needs a safety factor beyond simply having available head exceed required head.

item.title: IEC 104 Communication Protocol Explained
item.description: What IEC 60870-5-104 does, how it extends IEC 101 over TCP/IP, the master-slave request/response model, a security reference, and where it's used in SCADA.

item.title: Modbus vs PROFIBUS vs Foundation Fieldbus Explained
item.description: Modbus RTU/TCP, PROFIBUS DP/PA, and Foundation Fieldbus H1 compared with verified specs — physical layer, baud rate, max devices, distance, topology and where each is actually used.

item.title: SCADA (Supervisory Control & Data Acquisition) Explained
item.description: How SCADA works — the field/communication/supervisory architecture, the 5-step monitor-to-action loop, components, protocols, and SCADA vs DCS compared.

item.title: Power Factor Correction & Capacitor Banks Explained
item.description: Why low power factor costs money, how to size a capacitor bank (worked example), where to install it, and the harmonic resonance trap detuned reactors solve.
